4 routes. Base URL: `https://orbitwrite.com/api/v1`. Paths below are absolute.

| --- | --- | --- |

### POST /api/v1/ai/assistant

Run a composer assistant intent

Streams AI-generated text for one of the assistant panel's intents (refine, optimize, tone, translate, CTA, hashtags, promote a URL, generate, ideas). Scoped to the session's active workspace.

**Auth:** Session only (a browser login; an API key is refused)
**Rate limited:** yes (429 when the per-credential budget is spent)

**Request body** (`application/json`)

- `AiAssistantRequest`
  - variant 1: object
    - `intent`: one of `"refine"` | `"optimize_social"`, required
    - `text`: string (max length 25000), required
    - `platform`: string (max length 100)
    - `maxCharsPerPost`: integer
    - `accountId`: string
  - variant 2: object
    - `intent`: literal `"change_tone"`, required
    - `text`: string (max length 25000), required

    - `platform`: string (max length 100)
    - `maxCharsPerPost`: integer
    - `accountId`: string

    - `text`: string (max length 25000), required

    - `platform`: string (max length 100)
    - `maxCharsPerPost`: integer
    - `accountId`: string

  - variant 7: object

### POST /api/v1/ai/refine

Refine post text

Streams an edited version of the supplied post text for one of the refine palette's actions. The free-text `custom` action runs an abuse pre-flight (scope classifier + moderation). Scoped to the session's active workspace.

**Auth:** Session only (a browser login; an API key is refused)
**Rate limited:** yes (429 when the per-credential budget is spent)

**Request body** (`application/json`)

- `AiRefineRequest`
  - `prompt`: string (max length 25000), required
  - `action`: one of `"improve"` | `"grammar"` | `"spelling"` | `"punchier"` | `"shorten"` | `"expand"` | `"rewrite"` | `"announcement"` | `"structure"` | `"positive"` | `"split"` | `"poll"` | `"custom"`, required
  - `platform`: string (max length 100)
  - `maxCharsPerPost`: integer
  - `accountId`: string
  - `fullContext`: string (max length 25000)
  - `instruction`: string (max length 500)
  - `variation`: integer (min 0, max 10)

**Responses**

- `200` — The generated text stream
- `400` — Invalid request
  - `Error`
- `401` — Not signed in
  - `Error`
- `403` — Not a member of the organization
  - `Error`
- `422` — Custom instruction refused by the scope guard
  - `Error`
- `429` — Rate limit exceeded
  - `Error`
- `500` — OPENAI_API_KEY not configured
  - `Error`

### POST /api/v1/ai/campaign-plan

Plan campaign post angles from an article

Reads the article behind a campaign's source URL and breaks its content into `count` distinct post angles. Free-text sources return `reason: "not_url"` so the client can fall back to its template generator.

**Auth:** Session only (a browser login; an API key is refused)
**Rate limited:** yes (429 when the per-credential budget is spent)

**Request body** (`application/json`)

- `AiCampaignPlanRequest`
  - `source`: string (max length 4000), required
  - `count`: integer (min 1, max 40), required
  - `variation`: integer (min 0, max 50)

**Responses**

- `200` — The planned angles, or a not_url fallback signal
  - `AiCampaignPlanResult`
    - `ok`: boolean, required
    - `topics`: array of string
    - `title`: string | null
    - `truncated`: boolean
    - `reason`: string
    - `error`: string
- `400` — Invalid request
  - `Error`
- `401` — Not signed in
  - `Error`
- `422` — The URL couldn't be fetched or read
  - `Error`
- `429` — Rate limit exceeded
  - `Error`
- `502` — The model couldn't produce topics from the article
  - `Error`

### POST /api/v1/ai/campaign-name

Generate a campaign name

Generates a short campaign name from free-text context. Non-streaming.

**Auth:** Session only (a browser login; an API key is refused)

**Request body** (`application/json`)

- `AiCampaignNameRequest`
  - `context`: string (max length 500), required — Free-text topic the name is derived from

**Responses**

- `200` — The generated name
  - `AiCampaignNameResult`
    - `ok`: boolean, required
    - `name`: string
    - `error`: string
- `400` — Invalid request
  - `Error`
- `401` — Not signed in
  - `Error`
- `500` — OPENAI_API_KEY not configured
  - `Error`
